description: Local PostgreSQL logical restore drill for live Sign in with Apple nonce/code anti-replay records. Two synthetic live replay digests are consumed before backup, restored into a separate database, and the identical pair must still be rejected after restore. This is local-only logical restore evidence, not production PITR or Apple production traffic evidence.

requiredSteps: create clean source and target PostgreSQL databases
apply complete canonical migration sequence to source
consume one synthetic nonce digest and one synthetic authorization-code digest with a live TTL
verify exactly two live replay rows exist before backup
create a custom-format PostgreSQL logical dump
restore into a separate empty target database
verify both replay rows remain live after restore
attempt the identical replay pair through memory_auth_runtime
require duplicate replay consumption to fail closed
write privacy-safe exact-source result without raw replay digests
successCriteria: source replay row count is exactly two
pg_dump and pg_restore complete without ignored errors
restored replay row count is exactly two
memory_auth_runtime cannot consume the identical nonce/code pair again
result contains no replay digest values or database credentials
abortCriteria: source or target database identity is ambiguous
replay pair is absent or expired before backup
restored replay row count differs from two
duplicate replay consumption succeeds after restore
raw replay digests database URLs or credentials would enter evidence

evidenceBoundary.replayNonResurrectionScope: synthetic live nonce and authorization-code anti-replay records remain consumed across local logical restore
